title: JohnRPGGame Bethany Art Style Bible
purpose: Sole visual handoff contract for production environment, character, special-pose and portrait workers. Workers must not rely on session history.

usage.workerRule: Read this file and the owned prompt registry entry before generation. Match the approved masters; do not invent a separate style.

visualLanguage.name: Warm gently cartooned storybook realism
principles: Prioritize overall beauty, clarity and human warmth.
Use friendly simplified silhouettes and appealing proportions without chibi anatomy.
Keep faces, bodies and gestures believable, restrained and respectful.
Render stone, clay, wood, linen, skin, earth and vegetation with credible material response and subtle hand-painted texture.
Use clean shapes and readable value grouping suitable for gameplay, clicking and projection.
Stage narrative through map characters, poses and portraits rather than cinematic stills.
visualLanguage.finish: Polished hand-painted game art with clean forms, subtle texture and no forced pixel-art treatment.

mapRules: Show enough floor or ground to make routes, interaction areas and character placement readable.
Keep verticals, roof planes, doorways, furniture and props internally consistent across assets.
Favor cutaway or layered depth that can be decomposed into base, actor and foreground-occlusion layers.
Do not switch to eye-level cinematic, side-on platformer, orthographic plan or dramatic perspective views.
camera.portraitException: Dialogue portraits are chest-up close views, but must preserve the map character's identity, palette, materials and light direction.

palette.rule: Use this shared restrained palette. Hex values are production anchors, not flat-fill requirements.

materials.limestone: Warm, irregular, hand-set blocks with softened edges, restrained chips and readable joints; never glossy marble.
materials.clayAndTerracotta: Matte fired surfaces with subtle warm variation; pottery remains human-scaled and practical.
materials.wood: Simple hand-worked olive or local wood with visible grain and restrained wear; no ornate later-period furniture.
materials.linenAndWool: Natural weave, soft folds and muted dyes; clothing remains practical and first-century plausible.
materials.earthAndRoad: Dry compacted earth, pale stone and sparse grass with non-repeating natural variation and clear walkable values.
materials.vegetation: Dusty olive foliage, sparse Mediterranean plants and restrained flowers; no lush fantasy garden.
materials.skinAndHair: Believable Middle Eastern complexions, natural hair texture and softly simplified facial planes.
materials.tomb: Dry carved limestone and rock-cut architecture with a dark natural interior; respectful, clean and non-horror.

requirements: A standing adult fits naturally through the door with modest clearance.
The low bed supports one adult without appearing oversized or child-sized.
Tables, stools and shelves sit at practical human working and sitting heights.
Oil lamps, cups, bowls, jars, baskets and folded linen remain graspable household objects.
Keep a broad readable walkable floor and separate foreground occluders from the base room.
Do not bake characters, character shadows or movable story props into runtime environments.

outdoor.rule: Prioritize character readability over literal architecture scale while preserving a coherent environment.
requirements: Characters are deliberately enlarged relative to compact village houses and may visually approach the height of a small house facade.
The same character keeps identical face, age, hair, clothing colors and identity indoors and outdoors.
Roads, thresholds, wells, walls, tomb openings and gathering areas remain navigable and interaction-readable.
Use only a few figures in environment references; production environment assets contain no baked people or connected character shadows.

portrait.rule: The portrait is a detailed close-up of the approved map character, not a separate realistic actor or cinematic illustration.
requirements: Preserve face shape, age, hair, complexion, clothing layers, colors, materials and light direction.
Keep expression readable at UI size and emotionally restrained.
Use an unobtrusive background with no frame, border, text or iconography.

messenger.identity: Unnamed adult Jewish messenger and player character; alert, humble and practical.
messenger.clothing: Muted blue-gray linen tunic, sand mantle, leather sandals and a small travel satchel.

martha.identity: Adult Jewish woman with a practical, composed presence.
martha.clothing: Dark plum outer linen with warm earth-tone underlayers.
martha.acting: Concern, grief and conviction remain grounded and restrained.

mary.identity: Adult Jewish woman with a gentle but emotionally direct presence.
mary.clothing: Muted red outer linen with sand-colored underlayers.
mary.acting: Tenderness, urgency and grief remain human without theatrical collapse.

jesus.identity: Respectful first-century Jewish man with Middle Eastern appearance.
jesus.clothing: Undyed linen tunic and muted earth-tone mantle.

lazarus.identity: The same adult Jewish man across sick, burial-cloth and restored states.
lazarus.continuity: Preserve face, age, hair and body identity across every state.
states: weak on his side in simple linen clothing
standing respectfully wrapped in burial cloth with face visible
restored in a simple undyed tunic

disciples.identity: Three distinct first-century Jewish men sharing one visual language.
members: Thomas in muted brown and charcoal
younger disciple in sand and restrained rust

witnesses.identity: Restrained Bethany witnesses with quiet, human grief.

characterIdentities.continuityRule: For every named person, face, age, hair, complexion, clothing layers, colors and materials must remain stable across map sprites, special poses and portraits.

lighting.global: Natural Mediterranean light with soft readable shadow shapes, restrained contrast and no fantasy emission.
lighting.interior: Soft warm window light plus a restrained oil-lamp accent; preserve readable silhouettes and material color.
lighting.outdoor: Warm daylight with clear routes, readable characters and gentle olive-tree shadows.
lighting.tombGarden: Restrained late-afternoon light; the tomb interior is naturally dark and never emits light.
lighting.portraits: Match the corresponding map character's light direction and color temperature; enhance facial readability without studio glamour.

rules: Keep movable props visually separable with clean silhouettes.
Avoid connected cast shadows that prevent reuse.
Keep walkable routes and interaction zones readable before decorative detail.
The tomb entrance and round sealing stone must remain separate assets.

approvedMasters.knownLimitation: Walkable floor is adequate rather than expansive; derived runtime layouts must preserve a broader playable floor.

locks: village, well, meeting-area and tomb-road composition
warm limestone, olive and sand materials
approvedMasters.knownLimitation: Roof colors are slightly less terracotta-forward than the indoor palette; derived assets should retain restrained terracotta accents.

locks: separable rock-cut entrance and round stone
approvedMasters.knownLimitation: The tomb facade is modest in frame; derived assets must keep the entrance and stone readable at gameplay scale.

qualityGate: Overall composition is attractive and coherent.
Gently cartooned appeal and believable materials are both present.
Map assets use the approved three-quarter top-down RPG camera.
Setting, clothing, architecture and props are first-century plausible.
Indoor objects use believable human scale; outdoor characters are deliberately enlarged and readable.
Routes, interaction areas, layers and independent props are decomposable.
Palette, materials and lighting match the approved masters.
